name: Merge Versions (Scoped)
description: Merges repeated movies and episodes as versions of one item, scoped per folder, library or database, with preserved date added and automatic merging.
overview: Fork of Merge Versions with merge scopes, safety guards, date-added preservation and debounced auto-merge.

versions.changelog: Fix: date-added preservation could undo a merge (a stale pre-merge copy of the item was saved). Dates are now fixed before merging, on a fresh copy; automatic passes no longer react to merges and date edits. Re-run 'Merge All Movies/Episodes' once to repair affected titles.
Raise the per-group sanity cap from 3 to 10 versions (a title can legitimately arrive 4+ times); the same-name check still prevents accidental groups.
Add MergeScope (Folder/Library/Database), merge guards, PreserveDateAdded and automatic merging.
